service.method: SELECT USMT.MENU_PROFILE_CODE ,MAND.HOUSE_CODE ,MAND.COMPANY_CODE ,MAND.MAND_TYPE ,MAND.GIVE_COMPANY_CODE ,MAND.GIVE_USER_ID ,MAND.RECE_COMPANY_CODE ,MAND.RECE_USER_ID ,MAND.START_DATE ,MAND.END_DATE ,MAND.DESCRIPTION ,MAND.ADD_DATE ,MAND.ADD_TIME ,MAND.ADD_USER_ID ,MAND.CHANGE_DATE ,MAND.CHANGE_TIME ,MAND.CHANGE_USER_ID ,MAND.DELEGATION_KEY FROM SMAND MAND LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON MAND.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND MAND.GIVE_USER_ID = USMT.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND MAND.HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND MAND.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND MAND.RECE_USER_ID = ${ID} AND ${current.date} BETWEEN MAND.START_DATE AND MAND.END_DATE

SELECT CTRL_CODE, CTRL_TYPE, MAX(REPRESENT_CTRL) AS REPRESENT_CTRL FROM SBALN WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE IN (${COMPANY_CODE}) AND CTRL_PERSON_ID IN ($IN{IDS}) AND DEL_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY CTRL_CODE, CTRL_TYPE
SELECT HOUSE_CODE , USER_ID , PASS_CHECK_CNT , PW_RESET_FLAG FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND USER_ID = UPPER(${USER_ID})
SELECT HOUSE_CODE FROM SCMGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND REPRESENTATIVE_COMPANY_FLAG = 'Y' AND DEL_FLAG = 'N'
